profile_text.body:
Amazon is a public company founded in 1994 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington, United States. Its website describes it as an online shopping and entertainment destination offering free shipping on millions of items, Prime membership, and a product selection spanning fashion, home, beauty, electronics, Alexa Devices, sporting goods, toys, automotive, pets, baby, books, video games, musical instruments, and office supplies.

The site's own text does not describe AI products directly beyond the mention of Alexa Devices among its product categories. Third-party MCP servers listed in the record connect to Amazon data and services: one for Amazon Seller Central and Ads, one for Amazon Ads account queries, two for Amazon product search volume and demand trends, and one for live Amazon product, review, search, deal, offer, stock, and seller data across 20 marketplaces.

The record also notes a lawsuit, Haugland v. Anthropic PBC, in the District Court, D. Delaware, and law exposure in Washington with a count of 114. An SEC EDGAR company filing page is listed as a source.
